Project: `projects/<project>/`

### Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Approved scope is identified.
- [ ] Traceability gate passed.
- [ ] Functional/process scope is sufficiently defined.
- [ ] Required technical decisions are supported or explicitly open.
- [ ] Blocking findings are resolved or explicitly retained.
- [ ] Client/PO decisions are attached where required.
- [ ] No unsupported behavior was introduced.
